content.question: What distinguishes the sliding window variation of chain cross-validation for time series?
options: After each iteration, the train and test window is moved forward by a fixed number of time steps.
The training subset keeps increasing with every iteration.
The test set always contains the very first records of the series.
The folds are shuffled randomly before each iteration.
content.answer: After each iteration, the train and test window is moved forward by a fixed number of time steps.
